{"command": "create", "path": "/memories/session/plan.md", "file_text": "# Plan: Fix + harden tinymce-codemirror source view (highlighting + prettify)

## Confirmed root cause #1 (prettify)
`plugins/tinymce/codemirror/src/index.ts` only registers the format/pretty-print button
(`SOURCE_FORMAT_TOOLBAR_NAME`, `format()`) inside the `if (hasToolbar)` branch (~line 226-238).
The `if (hasFooter)` branch (~line 253-276) only ever creates a `</>` toggle button — no format
control at all. `packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl` configures
`display: "footer"`, so in both the scaffold app and the docs/guide/canvas-rce.md embed, the
prettify feature is dead code — the button/icon is never created, full stop. This is why
"prettify does nothing": there's no UI to invoke it.

## Unconfirmed (needs live-browser diagnosis) — syntax highlighting
Static review shows no obvious break: `@codemirror/{state,view,language}` resolve to single
versions across `pnpm-lock.yaml` (no duplicate-instance Facet bug), `codemirror`'s own lockfile
entry pins the same `@codemirror/language@6.12.4`/`@codemirror/state@6.7.5` as the catalog, and
`tinymce@8.9.1` still exposes `contentAreaContainer` (no API rename). The `syntaxHighlighting()` +
`HighlightStyle.define()` calls in `plugins/tinymce/codemirror/src/index.ts` (lines ~47-73, applied
via `themeCompartment` at ~156-160) look correct, and `dist/index.mjs` matches `src` (not a stale
build). Since line numbers/gutters/cursor render (confirmed by the attached screenshot) but zero
tag/attribute/string color renders, the bug is somewhere in runtime CSS application, not a missing
extension. Must be confirmed live before writing a fix.

## Steps

### Phase 0 — Unblock live verification (prerequisite, blocks Phase 1)
1. Fix the known-broken `.dev` scratch app per repo memory
   (`/memories/repo/scaffold-dev-scratch-app.md`): run `vp migrate` + `vp install` inside
   `packages/scaffold/.dev/canvas-theme-editor` to resolve the "Expected
   @voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@0.3.3, but found vite@8.2.2" stale alias.
2. Mirror the current `packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl` into
   `.dev/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts` (the `.dev` copy does not auto-update).
3. Serve the app (`vp dev` in that directory) and open DevTools on the TinyMCE source-view panel.

### Phase 1 — Diagnose highlighting live (depends on Phase 0)
Toggle into source mode and inspect, in priority order:
1. **Generated stylesheet presence** — check `document.styleSheets`/`<style>` tags for a
   CodeMirror `StyleModule`-mounted sheet containing the hex colors from `lightHighlighting`
   (`#800000`, `#ff0000`, `#0000ff`, etc.). If absent → the `syntaxHighlighting()` extension isn't
   being included in the actual `EditorState` (config/build issue). If present → go to 2.
2. **DOM class application** — inspect a `.cm-line` span for the lezer-generated highlight
   classes (e.g. `.ͼ...`). If the classes ARE applied but rendered black → a CSS specificity/order
   conflict is overriding them (check for ancestor rules from `@pantoken/components` foundation CSS,
   `app.css`'s `.instui-view`/utility classes, or TinyMCE's own `skin.css` bleeding into the sibling
   source container). If classes are absent from spans entirely → the lezer HTML parser isn't
   tagging tokens as expected (check `html()` from `@codemirror/lang-html` actually produces a tree
   with `tags.tagName` etc. — try logging `syntaxTree(view.state)`).
3. Also check computed `color` on `.cm-content`/`.cm-line` in DevTools — confirm nothing sets
   `color: inherit`/a fixed color with higher specificity or `!important` that wins over the
   generated highlight-style rule.
4. Record the confirmed cause (update this plan file / a repo memory note) before moving to Phase 2.

### Phase 2 — Fix prettify (no live diagnosis needed, already confirmed) — *parallel with Phase 1*
1. In `plugins/tinymce/codemirror/src/index.ts`, move the format button + icon registration out
   of the `if (hasToolbar)`-only branch so it's also available when `display === "footer"` (e.g.
   render a footer-adjacent format button/icon alongside the existing `</>` toggle in the
   `if (hasFooter)` block, reusing `format()`/`FORMAT_ICON_SVG`/`CODEMIRROR_STRINGS.sourceFormatTooltip`).
   Keep the toolbar branch working unchanged for `display: "toolbar"`/`"both"` consumers.
2. Per user decision: also auto-run `format()` once whenever entering source mode (inside `toggle()`,
   after `replaceDoc(editor.getContent())` and before/after `contentArea.style.display = "none"` —
   call `void format()` so the source view opens already pretty-printed). Manual format button stays
   available for re-formatting after edits.
3. Surface `format()` failures instead of silently swallowing them — the current
   `onAction: () => void format()` discards a rejected promise. Add a `.catch` that reports via
   `editor.notificationManager.open(...)` (or equivalent already-used pattern in this codebase —
   check `renderers/tinymce` for an existing notification helper to reuse) so a prettier parse
   failure doesn't fail silently, for both the manual button and the new auto-format-on-toggle call.

### Phase 3 — Fix highlighting (depends on Phase 1 findings)
Apply the specific fix matching the confirmed cause from Phase 1 (one of, adjust exact step once
confirmed):
- If CSS specificity conflict: scope/raise specificity of `lightTheme`/`darkTheme`/highlighting
  rules, or move the source container out from under whatever ancestor selector wins, or add a
  targeted override rule.
- If extension not included at runtime: fix the build/bundling gap (e.g. verify Vite isn't
  stripping it in the docs production build vs. dev — compare `vite build` output vs dev server
  behavior for `plugins/tinymce/codemirror`'s `syntaxHighlighting` call site).
- If parser/tag mismatch: adjust the `HighlightStyle.define()` tag list to match what
  `@codemirror/lang-html`'s grammar actually emits (verified via `syntaxTree` inspection in Phase 1).

### Phase 4 — Regression tests (depends on Phase 2 & 3 landing)
1. Extend `plugins/tinymce/codemirror/tests/source-toggle.test.ts` (happy-dom env) to assert,
   without needing real layout/paint:
   - Toggling on in `display: "footer"` mode still exposes a working `format()` and (new) that a
     format control DOM node exists in the footer (mirroring the existing toolbar assertions).
   - After the Phase 3 fix, that a mounted stylesheet/adopted stylesheet's `cssText` contains the
     expected highlight-style color values (e.g. asserts `#800000` appears somewhere in
     `document.head` `<style>` content after `ensureSourceView()` runs) — this is checkable in
     happy-dom since `StyleModule` mounting doesn't require real layout, only DOM/CSSOM presence.
   - Auto-format-on-toggle: entering source mode with unformatted HTML immediately yields
     pretty-printed content in `api.getContent()`, without a manual `api.format()` call.
2. Run `vp test --coverage` last (per user memory `coverage-workflow.md`).

### Phase 5 — Rebuild & verify end-to-end (depends on Phases 2-4)
1. Rebuild `plugins/tinymce/codemirror` (`vp pack` / package build) so `dist/index.mjs` reflects
   the fix.
2. Rebuild the docs embed: `node docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts` (per repo memory
   `tinymce-version-pin.md`'s note on rebuilding after `main.ts.tmpl`-adjacent changes) — note this
   fix lives in the plugin package, not the template, but rebuild anyway since docs' bundle pins a
   dependency on the plugin.
3. Mirror any `main.ts.tmpl` changes (if Phase 2/3 requires template-side wiring, e.g. switching
   `display` or passing new options) into `packages/scaffold/.dev/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts`
   per the scratch-app memory note.
4. Browser-verify in both the `.dev` scratch app and `docs:dev`'s `/guide/canvas-rce` page:
   toggle source view, confirm colored tags/attributes/strings in both light and dark
   (`data-pantoken-scheme`) modes, confirm the format button appears and works in footer mode,
   confirm auto-format-on-toggle produces pretty output immediately.
5. Run `vp check` and `vp test` (per repo-wide `copilot-instructions.md` review checklist).
6. Add a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) for `@pantoken/tinymce-codemirror` — note
   `.changeset/restore-codemirror-syntax-highlighting.md` and
   `.changeset/tinymce-toolbar-footer-reorg.md` already exist unreleased; check whether this new
   fix should be folded into one of those existing changesets or added as a new one (avoid

## Plan: Fix + harden tinymce-codemirror source view (highlighting + prettify)

**Confirmed root cause #1 (prettify):** In [plugins/tinymce/codemirror/src/index.ts](plugins/tinymce/codemirror/src/index.ts#L226-L276), the format/prettify button is only registered inside the `if (hasToolbar)` branch. The `hasFooter` branch only creates the `</>` toggle button — no format control at all. Since [main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L112-L131) uses `display: "footer"`, prettify has **no UI to invoke it** in either the scaffold app or the docs guide — that's not a subtle bug, it's dead code.

**Unconfirmed (needs live browser diagnosis) — syntax highlighting:** Static review rules out the classic causes (no duplicate `@codemirror/*` versions in the lockfile, `dist` matches `src`, `tinymce@8.9.1` still has `contentAreaContainer`, the `syntaxHighlighting()`/`HighlightStyle` code looks correct). Since gutters/line-numbers render but zero token color renders, the cause is likely a runtime CSS-injection/specificity issue that needs DevTools confirmation, not more guessing.

**Steps**
1. **Phase 0** — Unblock live verification: run `vp migrate`+`vp install` in the known-broken `.dev/canvas-theme-editor` scratch app, mirror `main.ts.tmpl` into it, serve it.
2. **Phase 1** *(depends on 1)* — Diagnose highlighting live: check generated stylesheet presence → DOM class application on tokens → CSS specificity/computed-color conflicts → parser tag mismatch.
3. **Phase 2** *(parallel with 1)* — Fix prettify: move format button registration into the footer branch too; add auto-format-on-entering-source-mode; surface `format()` promise rejections instead of silently swallowing them.
4. **Phase 3** *(depends on 1)* — Apply the specific highlighting fix matching the confirmed cause.
5. **Phase 4** *(depends on 2 & 3)* — Add DOM/CSS-assertion regression tests (stylesheet-content checks work fine under happy-dom, unlike layout) to `source-toggle.test.ts`; run `vp test --coverage` last.
6. **Phase 5** *(depends on 2-4)* — Rebuild plugin dist + `docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts`, mirror into `.dev` scratch app, browser-verify both light/dark in both instances, `vp check`/`vp test`, reconcile with the two existing unreleased changesets for this package before adding a new one.

**Relevant files**
- [plugins/tinymce/codemirror/src/index.ts](plugins/tinymce/codemirror/src/index.ts) — plugin logic
- [plugins/tinymce/codemirror/tests/source-toggle.test.ts](plugins/tinymce/codemirror/tests/source-toggle.test.ts) — tests to extend
- [packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl) — consumer wiring
- [docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts](docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts) — docs embed build

**Decisions**
- Diagnose live before fixing highlighting (per your choice), keep existing colors, add auto-format-on-toggle, add DOM/CSS assertion tests.

**Further Considerations**
1. Two existing unreleased changesets (`restore-codemirror-syntax-highlighting.md`, `tinymce-toolbar-footer-reorg.md`) already touch this package — check at implementation time whether either was an incomplete/reverted prior attempt at this same fix.
2. If highlighting root cause turns out to be systemic (not specific to our custom `HighlightStyle`), it may also affect the `#css-editor`/`#js-editor` panes in `main.ts.tmpl`, which rely only on `basicSetup`'s fallback highlighting — flag scope expansion once confirmed.

Full details saved to `/memories/session/plan.md`. Ready for implementation whenever you want to hand off.
